mormal.definition: n. A bad sore; a gangrene; a cancer.
mormal.translation: [地名] [白俄罗斯] 莫尔马利

mormon.definition:
n. the ancient prophet whose writings were revealed to Joseph Smith who founded the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints
a. of or pertaining to or characteristic of the Mormon Church

mormon church.translation: [网络] 摩门教；摩门教会；摩门教教堂

mormon tabernacle.translation: [网络] 摩门会幕；摩门礼拜堂；盐湖城摩门大会堂

mormondom.definition: n. The country inhabited by the Mormons; the Mormon people.
mormondom.translation: n. 摩门教教徒居住区

mormonism.definition: n. The doctrine, system, and practices of the Mormons.

mormonite.translation: n. 摩门教徒；一夫多妻主义者 (Mormon的变形)

mormons.definition:
n. church founded by Joseph Smith in 1830 with headquarters in Salt Lake City, Utah
n. the ancient prophet whose writings were revealed to Joseph Smith who founded the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints
n. a member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints
mormons.translation: n. 摩门教徒( Mormon的复数形式 )
